subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this gateway lifecycle change show a redacted live WeChat account-A/account-B QR-login run before merge, or is the focused gateway regression suite plus typecheck/build evidence sufficient?
rationale: Only a maintainer can decide whether the external-provider proof gate may be waived for this shared lifecycle change; the contributor has accurately stated that their environment cannot produce the live session.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Ask someone with an approved WeChat multi-account setup to attach redacted after-fix evidence that account A stays online while account B is added.

options.title: Accept gateway-level proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-level proof and merge based on the targeted lifecycle regressions and normal exact-head checks, accepting the remaining provider-integration uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Ask someone with an approved WeChat multi-account setup to attach redacted after-fix evidence that account A stays online while account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Initial review routing explicitly included this person for the affected gateway path, although the available provenance signal is limited.
